headline: Somatic structural variants called against germline-aware graph and composite references from long reads
label: Pangenome Somatic Variant Discovery
summary: Two long-read preprints call somatic SVs against pangenome graph or composite germline references, one without prior alignment, moving beyond a single linear reference.
synthesis: The dominant thread is anchoring somatic structural variant discovery to germline-informed references from tumor-normal long-read data. JANUS works directly in tumor-normal pangenome graphs from HiFi reads without prior alignment and is reported to outperform 18 callers. VESPA-SS instead computes tumor-specific strings against a draft composite germline reference from paired long-read WGS. What is new is treating the germline-aware graph or composite reference as the primary frame for somatic calling, including alignment-free formulations. GraffiTE, a Nextflow pipeline for genotyping SVs, annotating polymorphic transposable elements and mapping long-read methylation, is germline-oriented and only adjacent. ADZE 2.0, which extends rarefaction estimates of allelic richness to VCF data, is a population-genetic tool and not part of this thread.
